decisions.boundary_condition: Applies only to seat location. If seat selection is unavailable at booking or is deferred until check-in, note that limitation and try to secure a window seat at the earliest available time.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer a window seat by default when selecting a flight seat, while allowing another seat when requested, needed, or no acceptable window seat is available.
decisions.condition: When booking or selecting seats for flights where a seat location preference can be applied.
decisions.default_action: Prefer or request a window seat by default.
decisions.exception_condition: Use a different seat only if the user specifies another seat preference, needs a different seating arrangement, or no acceptable window seat is available.
decisions.name: prefers_window_seat_on_flights
decisions.rationale: The frozen representative is supported by three explicit examples across separate conversations and expresses a stable default flight seat-location preference with appropriate availability and user-override exceptions.
